applicabilityBasis.summary: USDH is a Bridge-issued USD-referenced payment token with issuer redemption at one dollar. The current USDH site directs holders to a Bridge redemption process after the USDH dashboard was withdrawn.

genius.licensingRegulator: State money-transmitter licenses for Bridge Building Inc., as identified in OCC CD-1365
genius.notes: USDH is frozen in the Pharos catalog. Bridge Open Issuance expressly includes USDH and advertises GENIUS-ready compliance, supporting issuer-announced-intent only. OCC CD-1365 conditionally approves the proposed Bridge National Trust Bank, a distinct Bridge Ventures LLC subsidiary, and describes Bridge Building Inc. as the existing state-licensed issuer. No opened source establishes that the proposed bank became the issuer of USDH; issuerPathway is therefore unknown for the retained Bridge Building Inc. issuerEntity. The former reserves and migration URLs now redirect to a redemption page saying the USDH dashboard is no longer available. No current public USDH reserve reconciliation or monthly independent attestation was retrievable there, so the presence flags are false for currently available disclosure; this does not deny historical reports. Bridge still provides a redemption procedure subject to eligibility and identity verification. not-yet-restricted describes GENIUS timing only and does not establish unrestricted distribution under other laws.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened federal proposals, SCRC certification procedure, state licensing list, issuer disclosures and targeted regulator-domain searches did not establish an issuer-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, or registered foreign exception for Bridge Building Inc. / USDH. Licensing or registration under earlier regimes is not such authorization. No public GENIUS-specific enforcement action was located in the checked sources; this is a bounded public-evidence review, not a legal compliance finding.
